title: Describe a Simple Day

source.reviewScope: Foundational A0/A1 practice, author-estimated difficulty. Final source senses,64objective questions and explicit package wording revisions reviewed. instructions: 按步骤先列关键词，再写自己的短句；参考示例不能作为自己的提交。
prompt: Write 80–100 words in short sentences about a fictional day. Say when you wake, what you wear, and what you do before or after class. Use at least six lesson words.

guidedOutput.title: 写作步骤提示
guidedOutput.text: 先写 My name is ... 和 I wake at ...；再写两件衣物；用 before 或 after 说课前/课后一件事；最后写 lunch 或 dinner。每一步可先写一两句，再连成自己的完整内容。

reference: My name is Hana. On class days, I wake at six. I get up and make my bed. I wash my face. Today I put on a shirt, a sock on each foot, and my shoes. The sun is out, but the room is cool. I take a quick look at the time. I start class at ten. I eat lunch at one. After class, I stay for five minutes and check a note. Then I leave. I eat dinner at six. Before dinner, I write a short plan for tomorrow.
referenceLabel: 原创 AI 示例，仅供学习，不是已完成的作品。
